issues.description: The Person.id field has inconsistent types between the template and the solution and is inconsistent inside the solution itself. In the template Person class the id field is declared as Long, matching the database changelog which creates 'id' as BIGINT. In the solution Person class the field is declared as Integer while its getter and setter use Long. This mismatch (Integer field vs Long accessors) is an internal type inconsistency in the solution and also conflicts with the template and the DB schema. This can cause compilation errors, incorrect equals/hashCode behavior, and mapping problems with the database schema (BIGINT vs Integer).
issues.suggestedFix: Use a single consistent type for the Person.id field across template, solution, and DB schema. Prefer changing the solution's Person.id field to Long (matching the template and the liquibase BIGINT column) and ensure the getter and setter also use Long. Alternatively, if Integer is desired, update the database changelog and template to use INT consistently, but keeping BIGINT/Long is recommended to match the existing changelog.
